item.title: Why BATUK Is Scaling Down Some Activities in Nanyuki Amid Protests

item.title: Sifuna Moves to Block Registration of Linda Wananchi as a Party in New Twist
item.description: The development comes at a time when the ODM party is facing internal wrangles, as the country heads towards the 2027 general elections.
